value: Municipal parking in downtown Granby has no fee: payment is required only in public lots listed « à péage » in annex F of by-law 1885-1990, and the only one listed is the Hôpital de Granby's (205, boulevard Leclerc Ouest); the parking-meter annex (E) was repealed
label: verified
note: Row P-1 of research/20c. Art. 56 and annexes E and F of the consolidated by-law (revised 2026-09-18). « Gratuit » is a reading of the official text, not a sentence the City publishes: no City page on downtown parking was found (granby.ca/fr/stationnement returns 404). The codification has no official sanction; the adopted by-laws and the street signs prevail.

value: In 2020 the by-law made downtown meters bearing a « Gratuit » sticker free, limited to 2 hours; by-law 1043-2021 (adopted 2021-06-07, in force 2021-06-12) then repealed art. 65 and annex E (meters), replaced art. 56 (paid zones) and added annex Y (downtown street parking)
label: verified
note: Row P-2. Historical table of the codification. A Granby Express article (April 2019, via BAnQ, search summary) reported the City's plan to remove the meters (see parking.history.press_2019).

value: Nearest municipal lot: « Stationnement Centre-Ville, entre les rues Court et Centre (41, rue Centre) », owned by the City; the by-law also calls it « Centre-Court »

note: Row P-3. Annex F-A item 1.0, art. 49, art. 45.3, art. 49.14 and annex BB; the annex Y map labels « Stationnement Centre-Court » between rue Court and rue du Centre.

value: Plan « Centre-Court » (annex BB), in force since 2026-06-12 (by-law 1479-2026): « Autorisé 4 h (8h-18h, Lun à Ven) » (central rows; 37 spaces per the draft); « Autorisé 2 h (8h-17h, Lun à Ven) »; one strip « Autorisé 2 h »; rows « Autorisé » with no time limit; two spaces « Réservé aux personnes handicapées »; rows reserved for permits « 40 rue Court » and « 12 rue Court »; one row « Interdit (1er Nov. au 30 Avr.) excepté véhicules munis d'un permis; Autorisé 2 h (8h-17h, Lun à Ven, 1er Mai au 31 Oct.) »; « Privé » spaces

note: Row P-4. Codification p. 142 (annex BB; plan revised 2026-06-03; amendment table « 1479-2026 — 2026-06-12 »); art. 49.14 cites by-law 1479-2026, art. 9. The number 37 comes from art. 8 of the draft tabled 2026-05-25: https://www.granby.ca/sites/default/files/2026-05/13.1-0-2026modregcirc-annexes-y-o-aa-bb.pdf

value: The 4-hour and 2-hour (8 h–17 h) limits in the Centre-Court lot apply Monday to Friday only: on Saturday and Sunday those spaces have no time limit
label: verified
note: Row P-5. Reading of the plan's labels (« Lun à Ven »). The plain « Autorisé 2 h » strip and the permit and reserved rows are not limited to weekdays. The signs on site prevail. The shop opens Wednesday to Sunday.

value: The Centre-Court plan labels two spaces « Réservé aux personnes handicapées »; art. 45.3 b) also reserves twelve vignette spaces in this lot for the Édifice Pierrette-Robichaud-Lafleur, « dont deux cases pour personnes handicapées »

Both texts are official, but it is unclear whether the two labelled spaces are open to any SAAQ vignette holder or belong to the building's twelve (art. 45.3 b, by-law 1409-2025): ask the City before publishing them (research/20c §9, item 5). Art. 45.01 (by-law 1479-2026) sets the vignette rule for reserved spaces.

value: From 1 November to 30 April, no parking on public roads, or in the public lots the by-law lists, between 1:00 and 6:30 when the City triggers a snow-removal operation.
